LightningComponentBundle.description: The AI Assist conversation chat window. Add it to the utility bar, or to a record page region at least 320px wide.

property.name: channel
property.label: Channel
property.description: Where the chat window runs - checked against each user's Allowed Channels. Leave as Utility Bar.

property.name: agentKey
property.label: AI Agent (optional)
property.description: An AI Agent Id or Developer Name to open with. Blank picks the first active Agent for the page's object.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent colour
property.description: Hex colour for buttons, your messages and highlights.
